ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates the finite crew-transfer package while retaining the complete hard-safety kernel.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact sealed crew transfer from accepted Ravensreach egress to the retained north passive rail endpoint.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No passenger/public access, boarding, vehicle, power, signal, service route, or passenger operation is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact source/target states, gravity containment order, retained rail/ladders, and inverse proofs are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block entity and fresh live entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled and rollback is exact reverse order on failure.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent crew-transfer QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failure blocks only this exact crew-transfer package.
